description: Germany only. Checklist for job interviews in Germany (Vorstellungsgespräch, Interviewfragen), Germany only. Use it when a founder prepares an interview or asks whether a question is allowed, e.g. about pregnancy (Schwangerschaft), religion, health or age under the AGG. Returns forbidden and sensitive topics with the reason, allowed questions, the method for structured questions with rating anchors and the interview flow.

form.description: Interview setting: vor_ort (in person) or telefon_video (phone or video)

senioritaet.description: Seniority of the role: ausbildung (apprenticeship or internship), berufseinstieg (entry level), berufserfahren (2 to 5 years), senior, fuehrungskraft (manager)

name: interviewfragen_check
title: Vorstellungsgespräch: erlaubte und verbotene Fragen
